name: GlotLID
description: GlotLID is a language identification model that supports over 2,000 labels, covering both high-resource and low-resource languages. Built on fastText, it provides reliable language detection across a wide spectrum of the world's linguistic diversity. It has been adopted by major projects including FineWeb2 and MaskLID.

name: Glot500
tagline: Language model and corpus for 500+ languages
description: Glot500 extends multilingual language models to cover more than 500 languages. By curating corpora and continued pre-training of XLM-R, Glot500 brings NLP capabilities to hundreds of previously unsupported languages, enabling downstream tasks like text classification and NER.

name: GlotScript
description: GlotScript provides tools for identifying writing systems at the character and text level following the ISO 15924 standard. It maps languages to their scripts and enables script-aware processing, crucial for multilingual NLP pipelines that must handle diverse orthographies.

name: GlotCC
description: GlotCC is a massive open corpus extracted from CommonCrawl, covering over 1,000 languages with approximately 2TB of text data. It uses GlotLID for language identification and careful quality filtering to produce clean, usable corpora for low-resource language research.

name: GlotWeb
description: GlotWeb indexes the web to find content in over 400 minority and low-resource languages. It provides a searchable directory of web resources, helping researchers and community members discover online content in their languages.

name: GlotOCR Bench
description: GlotOCR Bench is a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating optical character recognition systems across 158 Unicode scripts. It provides standardized test data and evaluation metrics to assess OCR quality for diverse writing systems, from Latin to rare scripts.

name: GlotStoryBook
description: GlotStoryBook collects and curates children's storybooks across 180 languages, providing parallel and comparable reading material. This resource supports literacy research, language documentation, and educational technology for underserved language communities.

name: GlotSparse
description: GlotSparse provides curated news corpora for under-resourced languages, sourced from diverse news outlets. It addresses the data scarcity problem by collecting, cleaning, and organizing news text for languages that lack large-scale text resources.
